messages.subject: lavaan 0.5-15 on CRAN
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

A new update of lavaan (0.5-15) has been released on CRAN a few days
ago. This is maintenance release, with little user-visible changes, but
many changes behind-the-scenes.

Two 'new' features that are perhaps of interest for those using
categorical (endogenous) variables:

- new 'zero.add' argument gives you more flexibility on how to deal with
missing values in bivariate frequency tables

- the lavTables() function has been revised. Below are a few examples of
how the function can be used.

I plan another update (0.5-16) of the 0.5 series (hopefully before the
end of the year), and this one will be the last of the 0.5 series. In
January 2014, 0.6 development will start.

Yves.

--
Yves Rosseel -- http://www.da.ugent.be
Department of Data Analysis, Ghent University
http://lavaan.org


### lavTables() examples 0.5-15 ###

library(lavaan)
HS9 <- HolzingerSwineford1939[,c("x1","x2","x3","x4","x5",
"x6","x7","x8","x9")]
HSbinary <- as.data.frame( lapply(HS9, cut, 4, labels=FALSE) )
HSbinary$school <- HolzingerSwineford1939$school

model <- ' trait =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 '
fit <- cfa(model, data=HSbinary, ordered=names(HSbinary),
group = "school")

# lavTables + data

# pattern
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=0, group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary))
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=0, group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary),
stat="G2.un")

# oneway
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=1, group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary))
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=1, group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary),
stat="th.un")

# two-way cells
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="cells", group="school",
categorical=names(HSbinary))
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="cells", group="school",
categorical=names(HSbinary), output="table")

lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="cells", group="school",
categorical=names(HSbinary), stat="G2.un")
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="cells", group="school",
categorical=names(HSbinary), output="table", stat="G2.un")
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="cells", group="school",
categorical=names(HSbinary), output="table", stat="X2.un")

# two-way tables
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="table",
group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary))
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="table",
group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary), output="table")

lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="table",
group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary), stat="cor.un")
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="table",
group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary), output="table",
stat="cor.un")

lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="table",
group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary), stat="G2.un")
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="table",
group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary), output="table",
stat="G2.un")
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="table",
group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary), stat="X2.un")
lavTables(HSbinary, dim=2, type="table",
group="school", categorical=names(HSbinary), output="table",
stat="X2.un")




# lavTables + fit

# pattern
lavTables(fit, dim=0)
lavTables(fit, dim=0, stat="G2")

# oneway
lavTables(fit, dim=1)
lavTables(fit, dim=1, stat=c("th.un","th","G2","X2"))

# two-way cells
lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="cells")
lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="cells", output="table")

lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="cells", stat="X2")
lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="cells", output="table", stat="X2")

lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="cells", stat=c("cor", "cor.un"))
lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="cells", output="table", stat="cor")

# two-way tables
lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="table")
lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="table", output="table", stat="G2.average")
lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="table", output="table", stat="G2")

lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="table", stat=c("cor.un", "cor"))
lavTables(fit, dim=2, type="table", output="table", stat="cor")
